
var gartDeclaredTCP = len(resolveTCPAddrTests)
var gartDeclaredUDP = len(resolveUDPAddrTests)
var gartDeclaredIP = len(resolveIPAddrTests)

type gartResolverInput struct {
 Network, Address string
 IP []byte
 Port int
 Zone string
}

func TestGartResolverInputs(t *testing.T) {
 var inputs struct {
  TCP, UDP, IP []gartResolverInput
 }
 for _, tt := range resolveTCPAddrTests[gartDeclaredTCP:] {
  if tt.err != nil || tt.addr == nil { t.Fatal("TCP setup no longer contains only successful addresses") }
  inputs.TCP = append(inputs.TCP, gartResolverInput{tt.network, tt.litAddrOrName, []byte(tt.addr.IP), tt.addr.Port, tt.addr.Zone})
 }
 for _, tt := range resolveUDPAddrTests[gartDeclaredUDP:] {
  if tt.err != nil || tt.addr == nil { t.Fatal("UDP setup no longer contains only successful addresses") }
  inputs.UDP = append(inputs.UDP, gartResolverInput{tt.network, tt.litAddrOrName, []byte(tt.addr.IP), tt.addr.Port, tt.addr.Zone})
 }
 for _, tt := range resolveIPAddrTests[gartDeclaredIP:] {
  if tt.err != nil || tt.addr == nil { t.Fatal("IP setup no longer contains only successful addresses") }
  inputs.IP = append(inputs.IP, gartResolverInput{tt.network, tt.litAddrOrName, []byte(tt.addr.IP), 0, tt.addr.Zone})
 }
 data, err := gartjson.Marshal(inputs)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 fmt.Printf("GART_RESOLVER_INPUTS %s\n", data)
}
